title: Simultaneous analysis of multi-class antibiotics in bottled water using large-volume direct-injection LC-MS/MS
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,16973-16982
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA01764E, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Haijun Wang, Qiao Zhang, Xiaolin Li, Huan Chen, Xiaolan Zhu, Liming Yang, Hongling Yin, Jing Sun, Shuhong Fang, Hui Zhang
A large-volume direct-injection (LVDI) method was developed and validated for the simultaneous analysis of 69 antibiotics in bottled water using ultra-high performance liquid chromatography-tandem mass spectrometry (UHPLC-MS/MS).
